jobs.name: auto-sign-and-broadcast
jobs.message:
You are a non-interactive automated task. Do NOT ask the user any questions. Do everything autonomously.

Your job:
1. Call list_sign_requests_ready to find any sign requests that are ready for Get Sig / Execute.
2. If none are found, stop — nothing to do.
3. If one or more are found, process them ONE AT A TIME (do not process multiple in parallel):
   a. For the first ready request, call get_sign_result_summary to check its status.
   b. If readyToBroadcast is true and executedOnChain is false, call broadcast_sign_result with the requestId to execute it on-chain. Wait for confirmation, then move to the next ready request.
   c. If readyToBroadcast is false and the request needs signing (MPC quorum reached but not yet signed), call trigger_sign_result with feeSpeedTier "normal" to trigger MPC signature generation if it was not set explicitly in TxParams. After trigger completes, call get_sign_result_summary again to confirm readyToBroadcast is true, then call broadcast_sign_result to execute it on-chain.
   d. After successfully broadcasting, move on to the next ready request and repeat the same process.
4. If at any point a broadcast or trigger fails, log the error but continue processing remaining requests.
5. When all ready requests have been processed (or none were found), you are done.

Important rules:
- Process requests one at a time, sequentially.
- Never ask the user for input, confirmation, gas preferences, or fee speed. Always use feeSpeedTier "normal".
- Never ask about useCustomGas — always use the default (false equivalent).
- If a request is already executed on-chain, skip it.
- If a request is blocked or shelved, skip it.
- Be thorough: after triggering a sign, poll or check until readyToBroadcast before broadcasting.

jobs.name: auto-accept-sign-request
jobs.message:
Skip ContinuumDAO governor requests (evm.type continuum_dao_propose, continuum_dao_cast_vote, continuum_dao_execute, continuum_dao_cancel). Do not auto-Accept a propose. Those rows belong to conditional-accept-governance-vote.

You are a non-interactive automated task. Do NOT ask the user any questions. Do everything autonomously.

Your job:
1. Call list_sign_requests_awaiting_join to find multiSignRequest proposals where this node is in KeyList and has not yet agreed (Join tab Accept work).
2. If none are found with localAgreementPending: true, stop — nothing to do.
3. If one or more are found, process them ONE AT A TIME (do not process multiple in parallel):
   a. For the first pending request, call sign_request_agree with requestId, accept: true, and thoughts set to: "Sign request agreed to automatically at <current date and time in ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-07-20T12:55:00Z>."
   b. After a successful agree, move to the next pending request and repeat (use a fresh timestamp in thoughts for each agree).
4. If sign_request_agree fails for a request, log the error but continue processing remaining pending requests.
5. When all pending requests have been accepted (or none were found), you are done.

Important rules:
- Process requests one at a time, sequentially.
- Never ask the user for input or confirmation.
- Always pass thoughts on every sign_request_agree call in the form: "Sign request agreed to automatically at <ISO 8601 UTC timestamp>." — include the actual current UTC date and time for each call; do not omit thoughts or ask the operator for a comment.
- Always accept (accept: true) — never reject.
- Do NOT call trigger_sign_result, broadcast_sign_result, or create new multiSignRequest proposals — only agree to existing requests awaiting this node's Join acceptance.
- Skip requests where localAgreementPending is false (this node already agreed).
- Skip blocked, shelved, expired, or success lifecycle requests.

jobs.name: conditional-accept-sign-request
jobs.message:
This is the TRADE sign_request_agree job. It must not handle ContinuumDAO governor Join.

GOVERNOR vs TRADE: This job is TRADE Join only. ContinuumDAO governor requests are NOT this job — do not Accept or Reject them. Identify governor requests from get_sign_request_by_id: evm.type is continuum_dao_propose, continuum_dao_cast_vote, continuum_dao_execute, or continuum_dao_cancel; or signatureText JSON kind ContinuumDAO with name ContinuumDAO.propose / castVote / execute / cancel. If governor: SKIP (no sign_request_agree). Leave for catalog job conditional-accept-governance-vote. If evm.protocolId is continuum-dao and it is not a ctm1 trade: also SKIP (escrow/lock/attach are not this job). 

You are a non-interactive automated task. Do NOT ask the user any questions. Do everything autonomously.

Your job:
1. Call list_sign_requests_awaiting_join to find multiSignRequest proposals where this node is in KeyList and has not yet agreed (Join tab Accept work).
2. If none are found with localAgreementPending: true, stop — nothing to do.
3. If one or more are found, process them ONE AT A TIME (do not process multiple in parallel):
   a. For the first pending request, call get_sign_request_by_id with compact: false.
   b. Read the Purpose map value for the originator node key (128-hex key in the Purpose object).
   c. Split Purpose on " · " (space-dot-space): structured ctm1 prefix before the dot, additional prose after. If Purpose does not start with ctm1|, treat the entire string as additional prose.
   d. Parse the ctm1 prefix: ctm1|{proto}|{L|S}|{setup}|key=value tokens|{symShort}. Use proto, setup, symShort, sz= (coin units), szUsd= (USD notional) for policy. Interpret additional prose against purposeText rules in signAcceptPolicy below.
   e. Evaluate every enabled rule in the signAcceptPolicy YAML fence below (originator allowlist, purposeCodes, purposeText keywords and interpretationNotes, chains, tokens, amountLimits, rejectIfLivePosition). Use get_chain_registry / get_token_registry when resolving names. For live-position checks: load_defi_protocol then ctm_gmx_fetch_positions, ctm_hyperliquid_fetch_positions, or ctm_arcus_fetch_positions; derive executorAddress from keyGenId when required.
   f. If ALL enabled rules pass: sign_request_agree with accept: true and thoughts: "Sign request agreed automatically at <ISO 8601 UTC>. Purpose: <complete purpose string>. All signAcceptPolicy conditions passed."
   g. If ANY enabled rule fails: sign_request_agree with accept: false and thoughts: "Sign request rejected automatically at <ISO 8601 UTC>. Purpose: <complete purpose string>. Reason: <specific failing rule>."
   h. Move to the next pending request and repeat (fresh UTC timestamp each call).
4. If sign_request_agree fails for a request, log the error but continue processing remaining pending requests.
5. When all pending requests have been processed (or none were found), you are done.

Important rules:
- Process requests one at a time, sequentially.
- Never ask the user for input or confirmation.
- Always call sign_request_agree for every evaluated request — accept when policy passes, reject when any rule fails (do not skip reject on policy failure).
- Always cite the complete Purpose (ctm1 codes AND additional prose) in thoughts.
- Evaluate BOTH structured ctm1 codes AND additional Purpose prose (purposeText rules + interpretationNotes).
- Do NOT call trigger_sign_result, broadcast_sign_result, or create new multiSignRequest proposals.
- Skip requests where localAgreementPending is false. Skip blocked, shelved, expired, or success lifecycle requests.
- For batch requests: reject if any leg would fail policy (safest default).
- Full template and examples: agent_llm_config.defaults/cron/sign_accept_policy.example.md

signAcceptPolicy:
```yaml
version: 1

requireCtm1: true

originatorNodeKeys: []

purposeCodes:
  allowedProtocols: [hl, arc, gmx, uni]
  blockedProtocols: []
  allowedSetups: [trend-ret, kl-bnc, kl-fib, bb-fade, fw-ret, fw-bnc, ew-imp, ew-dia]
  blockedSetups: []
  allowedSymbols: []
  allowedSides: [L, S]

purposeText:
  blockedKeywords: [force, experimental, test-only, manual override]
  requiredKeywordsAny: []
  requiredKeywordsAll: []
  allowedKeywordsAny: []
  interpretationNotes: |
    Reject additional Purpose prose mentioning experimental sizing or manual override.
    Accept desk suffixes (trend retest, kl bounce, Generated by cron) when otherwise allowed.

chains:
  chainIds: []

tokens: []

amountLimits:
  mode: per_request
  limits: []

rejectIfLivePosition:
  enabled: false
  protocols: [gmx, hyperliquid, uniswap-v4, arcus]
  matchBy: same_market
```

jobs.name: appraise-and-vote-proposals
jobs.message:
You are a non-interactive automated task. Do NOT ask the user any questions. Do everything autonomously.

Load skills scheduled-automation, continuum-dao-proposals, continuum-dao-proposal-standards, and continuum-dao-vote-policy. Follow votePolicy in continuum-dao-vote-policy. Never load continuum-dao-compose-proposal.

This job may ONLY vote. It must NEVER create a proposal, register a proposal, execute, cancel, trigger_sign_result, or broadcast_sign_result.

Your job:
1. continuum__load_defi_protocol({ protocolId: "continuum-dao" }).
2. continuum__ctm_continuum_dao_fetch_live_proposals with Linea chainId 59144 (or 59141) and rpcUrl from the chain registry. Pass governor if the constant is zero.
3. For each row in `live` (Active) only, one at a time:
   a. continuum__ctm_continuum_dao_explain_proposal with that id/onchainId. Read briefing.
   a2. If forumKey is a /topic/:tid or /t/:tid URL: forum_resolve then forum_fetch_thread (index 0) and forum_reply_count. Read only — do not forum_create_topic, sign in, reply, or react.
   b. Appraise against votePolicy. Trusted proposers are any EOA or contract (not KeyGens).
   c. If defaultAction/skip/unknown: do nothing for that proposal.
   d. If stance is against/abstain/nota (or for only if votePolicy explicitly allows For — the catalogue default never does):
      call only ctm_continuum_dao_build_cast_vote_bravo_multisign or ctm_continuum_dao_build_cast_vote_delta_multisign (Delta weights = nOptions+1, last slot NOTA).
4. When all live rows are processed, stop.
5. End with a concise operator summary as your final message (what you voted, skipped, or why nothing ran). Do not call send_telegram_message — this job has telegramNotify and the host delivers that summary.

Forbidden tools: propose_bravo, propose_delta, register_proposal, forum_create_topic, forum_sign_in, forum_reply, forum_react, execute, cancel, create_compose_multi_sign_request for propose, trigger_sign_result, broadcast_sign_result, sign_request_agree.

jobs.name: conditional-accept-governance-vote
jobs.message:
You are a non-interactive automated task. Do NOT ask the user any questions. Do everything autonomously.

Load skills scheduled-automation, continuum-dao-proposals, continuum-dao-proposal-standards, and continuum-dao-vote-policy. Never load continuum-dao-compose-proposal.

This is the GOVERNOR Join job (sign_request_agree only). It is NOT the trade job conditional-accept-sign-request.

Your job:
1. list_sign_requests_awaiting_join. If none with localAgreementPending true, stop.
2. Process ONE request at a time. get_sign_request_by_id({ compact: false }).
3. Classify:
   - Governor if evm.type is continuum_dao_propose, continuum_dao_cast_vote, continuum_dao_execute, or continuum_dao_cancel, or signatureText.kind is ContinuumDAO with those names.
   - Otherwise SKIP (do not agree). Leave trades for conditional-accept-sign-request.
4. If continuum_dao_propose / ContinuumDAO.propose: sign_request_agree accept false. thoughts: rejected automatically at <ISO 8601 UTC>. Reason: governor Join cron never accepts a propose.
5. If continuum_dao_execute or continuum_dao_cancel: sign_request_agree accept false. Reason: execute/cancel not allowed by this job.
6. If continuum_dao_cast_vote:
   a. explain_proposal for the proposalId in metadata/signatureText. If forumKey is a topic URL, forum_resolve + forum_fetch_thread (read only).
   b. Appraise votePolicy (trustedProposers = any EOA/contract).
   c. Accept only if the request stance matches what votePolicy would cast (Bravo 0/1/2 or Delta weights including NOTA).
   d. If skip/unknown/wrong-way stance: accept false. Cite the rule.
7. Continue to the next pending request.

Never call trigger_sign_result, broadcast_sign_result, or any propose/vote/execute build tool.
Skip blocked, shelved, expired, or already-agreed rows.
Full template: agent_llm_config.defaults/cron/continuum_dao_vote_policy.example.md

jobs.name: notify-forum-replies
jobs.message:
You are a non-interactive automated task. Do NOT ask the user any questions. Do everything autonomously.

Load skills scheduled-automation and continuum-dao-forum-replies. Load continuum-dao-proposals only for Forum post presentation (composer markdown, not HTML). Never load continuum-dao-compose-proposal.

This job is READ-ONLY. It must NEVER sign in, reply, react, delete, create a topic/idea, vote, propose, or call send_telegram_message. This job has telegramNotify — the host DMs your final assistant message after a successful run.

forumWatch:
```yaml
forumWatch:
  forumUsername: REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_FORUM_USERNAME
```

Your job:
1. Read forumWatch.forumUsername from this message. If it is still REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_FORUM_USERNAME or empty: end with a short final message telling the operator to set their NodeBB username (interactive forum_me after sign-in, then edit this job) and stop. Do not call forum_me from cron (needs a ticket).
2. continuum__load_defi_protocol({ protocolId: "continuum-dao" }).
3. Read watch state with agent_read_file path data/cron/notify-forum-replies.yaml. If the file is missing, this run is a baseline (record current watermarks; do not treat existing replies as new).
4. Paginate continuum__ctm_continuum_dao_forum_user_post_ids({ username }) until nextStart is null. Collect all pids.
5. For each pid, continuum__ctm_continuum_dao_forum_fetch_post. Group by tid. Note toPid when the payload includes it.
6. For each distinct tid:
   a. forum_fetch_thread with index 0 (OP username + title). forum_resolve for the topic URL. forum_reply_count.
   b. A reply is "to you" if the OP username equals forumUsername (case-insensitive), or the reply's toPid is one of your pids.
   c. Skip replies authored by forumUsername (self-replies).
   d. On later runs, only posts with pid greater than that thread's stored lastNotifiedPid.
   e. Page forum_fetch_thread (omit index; start/limit) to fetch new reply bodies.
7. Write updated state with agent_write_file to data/cron/notify-forum-replies.yaml:
```yaml
forumWatchState:
  version: 1
  forumUsername: <username>
  updatedAt: <ISO 8601 UTC>
  threads:
    "<tid>":
      title: "..."
      replyCount: N
      lastNotifiedPid: N
```
8. Final message (this is the Telegram body — do not call send_telegram_message):
   - Username still unset, or a blocking tool error: short operator-facing error.
   - First successful baseline: one line, e.g. "Forum reply watch baseline saved for <username>: <n> threads. Telegram will fire when someone replies."
   - New replies: include each formatted Forum post so Telegram contains the body. Heading = thread title; then topic URL; then **author** · createdAt; then the post content as markdown (do not wrap the body in a code fence). If content is HTML or NodeBB-only markup, summarize in plain language. Cap 10 newest. Do not paste the YAML state file.
   - Later runs with no new replies: EMPTY final message (no words) so Telegram is not sent.
9. Keep the notify body under ~16k characters.

Forbidden tools: forum_sign_in, forum_sign_out, forum_me, forum_unread, forum_mark_read, forum_mark_unread, forum_reply, forum_react, forum_delete, forum_create_topic, forum_create_idea, send_telegram_message, propose/vote/execute/cancel builders, sign_request_agree, trigger_sign_result, broadcast_sign_result.
